tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Ricci and injectivity imply simple connectivity]

Source: petersen:page-0280 ↗ thm:pet-ch6-submanifold-connectivity ↗ thm:pet-ch6-myers-ricci-diameter 1. ch6:6.5.7If $M$ is a closed $n$-manifold with $\operatorname {Ric}\ge (n-1)$ and $\operatorname {inj}_p>\pi /2$ for some $p\in M$, then $M$ is simply connected.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch6-submanifold-connectivity ↗ thm:pet-ch6-myers-ricci-diameter \sketch The Ricci bound and summed second variation give every nonconstant loop at $p$ index at least one. Submanifold connectivity with $A={p}$ yields simple connectivity.

□
